rulesBaseline: 2025 base game with August 17, 2026 timing update
copyrightNote: Names and mechanical facts are retained for compatibility. UI summaries are paraphrased implementation descriptions, not card-text reproductions.

racers.name: Alchemist
racers.uiSummary: After the main-move die is finalized as 1 or 2, Alchemist may use 4 as the main-move amount instead.
implementation: Keep the finalized die face unchanged; replace only the movement amount.
Prompt only on finalized 1 or 2.
edgeCases: A finalized 1 may still matter to die-face reactions; test ordering with Inchworm and Skipper.

racers.name: Blimp
racers.uiSummary: At turn start, Blimp gets +3 to its main-move amount while it is before the track’s second-corner threshold; on or after that threshold it gets -1 instead.
implementation: Read the threshold from track.secondCornerPosition.
Determine the modifier from Blimp position at the start of the turn.
edgeCases: Do not infer the corner from screen coordinates.

racers.name: Coach
racers.uiSummary: Any racer currently sharing Coach’s space gets +1 to its main-move amount, including Coach.
implementation: Check settled board state when main-move amount is calculated.
Coach benefits from its own aura.
edgeCases: Legs’ fixed 5 is still a main move and is modified by Coach.

racers.name: Baba Yaga
racers.uiSummary: Trip another racer when that racer stops on Baba Yaga’s space, or when Baba Yaga stops on a space occupied by another racer.
implementation: Evaluate only after an arrival is settled.
Under the current erratum, suppress stop-together triggers caused only by simultaneous co-arrival.
edgeCases: Duelist may still be able to duel before/around the resulting trip according to priority.
Hypnotist can warp Baba Yaga onto its own space, but the Hypnotist is then a trip target unless simultaneous-arrival suppression applies.

racers.name: Centaur
racers.uiSummary: Whenever Centaur passes a racer during a move, that passed racer moves backward 2 spaces, never behind Start.
implementation: Determine passing from the complete move start/end positions.
Generate one backward-2 MOVE for each passed racer.
Clamp at position 0.

racers.name: Copy Cat
racers.uiSummary: Copy Cat continuously uses the power of the currently leading active racer. If multiple racers are tied for the lead, Copy Cat chooses one to copy.
implementation: Resolve copied power dynamically from current lead state.
Never copy a BEFORE_RACE power.
If a copied power conflicts with the original racer’s same power, the original racer has priority.
During one indivisible action, do not switch copied source midway merely because the lead tie changes.
If Copy Cat is the sole leader, do not recursively copy itself; treat it as having no external copied power until another eligible lead source exists.
edgeCases: A tie-selection prompt may be required when the eligible leader set changes outside an indivisible action.

racers.name: Banana
racers.uiSummary: Any racer that passes Banana during a move becomes tripped after completing that move.
implementation: Queue trip after the passing move is completed; never truncate the move.
edgeCases: Starting on Banana’s space and ending ahead is not a pass because the racer did not start behind Banana.

racers.name: Cheerleader
racers.uiSummary: Before Cheerleader’s main move, it may make every racer currently tied for last move forward 2. If it does, Cheerleader then moves forward 1.
implementation: Snapshot the tied-last set when the power is chosen.
Move all applicable last-place racers by 2 according to the game’s multi-move resolution rules.
Then perform one separate +1 MOVE for Cheerleader.
edgeCases: If Cheerleader is itself in last, its +2 and subsequent +1 are two separate moves.
Only one +1 Cheerleader move occurs regardless of number of last-place racers.

racers.name: Dicemonger
racers.uiSummary: Every racer may use one additional reroll of its main-move die per turn. When another racer uses the reroll granted by Dicemonger, Dicemonger moves forward 1 before that racer resolves its movement.
implementation: Track once-per-turn use per racer.
Tag rerolls with rerollSource.
Move Dicemonger only when another racer uses rerollSource=dicemonger.
Resolve Dicemonger’s +1 before the rerolling racer performs its eventual main move.
edgeCases: Magician’s own POOF rerolls do not themselves make Dicemonger move; a separate Dicemonger-granted reroll does.
Scoocher reacts to actual power occurrences.

racers.name: Duelist
racers.uiSummary: Whenever another racer is settled on Duelist’s space, Duelist may challenge that racer. Both roll a D6; the higher roll moves forward 2, and Duelist wins ties.
implementation: Do not interrupt an indivisible action such as the interval between an accepted die roll and its movement.
If accepted, roll for Duelist and the chosen shared racer; Duelist wins ties; winner performs a +2 MOVE.
Allow multiple duels if the trigger arises multiple times.
edgeCases: Can trigger outside Duelist owner’s normal turn.
Current simultaneous-arrival erratum can suppress triggers created solely by co-arrival.

racers.name: Genius
racers.uiSummary: Before rolling for its main move, Genius may predict a die face. If the finalized roll matches, Genius receives another full turn after this one.
implementation: Prompt for either no prediction or a value 1–6 before the roll.
Compare prediction with final accepted die face after rerolls.
If correct, enqueue an extra Genius turn immediately after the current turn.

racers.name: Heckler
racers.uiSummary: Whenever any racer ends its turn no more than 1 track space away from where that racer began the turn, Heckler moves forward 2.
implementation: Store each active racer’s position at its turn start.
At turn end, compare absolute position difference <= 1.
If condition holds, Heckler performs a +2 MOVE.
edgeCases: A racer that spends its turn recovering from trip has zero displacement and can trigger Heckler.

racers.name: Egg
racers.uiSummary: Before Egg’s race, draw 3 racers from the still-unused racer deck, choose 1, and let Egg use that racer’s powers for this race.
implementation: Draw three valid undealt/unused racer definitions.
Prompt Egg owner to choose one.
Egg keeps Egg identity/token but delegates powers to the chosen racer.
Copied BEFORE_RACE powers also apply.
edgeCases: Do not draw racers already drafted, used, or otherwise unavailable according to deck state.

racers.name: Gunk
racers.uiSummary: Every other racer gets -1 to its main-move amount.
implementation: Reduce movement amount, not die face.
Clamp an effective amount below zero to zero; a move of zero is not a move.
edgeCases: A finalized 6 is still a 6 for Lackey even if movement becomes 5.
Scoocher can react to each application of Gunk’s power as specified by the rules.

racers.name: Huge Baby
racers.uiSummary: Outside Start, no other racer may remain on Huge Baby’s space. If an effect would leave another racer there, place that racer on the immediately preceding space instead.
implementation: Start is exempt.
Apply the restriction whenever a settled state would illegally share Huge Baby’s non-Start space.
The relocation behind Huge Baby is not a MOVE; treat the displaced racer as having stopped on that new space.
edgeCases: Original Huge Baby power takes priority over a conflicting Copy Cat copy.
Never displace behind position 0.

racers.name: Flip Flop
racers.uiSummary: Instead of rolling for its main move, Flip Flop may swap positions simultaneously with any other active racer.
implementation: Prompt: roll normally or choose a swap target.
If swap chosen, do not roll.
Warp both racers simultaneously; this is not movement and creates no passing.
Mark the main move as replaced/consumed.

racers.name: Hare
racers.uiSummary: Hare gets +2 to its main-move amount, but if it starts its turn alone in the lead it skips its main move.
implementation: At turn start snapshot whether Hare is alone in lead.
If yes, skip the main move. Otherwise add +2 to movement amount.

racers.name: Hypnotist
racers.uiSummary: Before its main move, Hypnotist may warp any active racer onto Hypnotist’s current space.
implementation: Prompt for no use or one active racer target.
Warp target to Hypnotist position.
Then Hypnotist still proceeds to its main move.

racers.name: Inchworm
racers.uiSummary: When another racer’s finalized main-move die is 1, that racer skips the movement and Inchworm moves forward 1.
implementation: Trigger only after reroll decisions make 1 the final die face.
Cancel the affected racer’s main-move movement, not its whole turn.
Inchworm performs +1 MOVE.
edgeCases: If Skipper is also active, Inchworm moves first, then Skipper takes the next turn.

racers.name: Legs
racers.uiSummary: Instead of rolling, Legs may take a main move with a base movement amount of 5.
implementation: Prompt: roll or use fixed 5.
Using JOG is still the racer’s main move.
Apply main-move modifiers such as Gunk and Coach to the base 5.

racers.name: Mastermind
racers.uiSummary: At the start of Mastermind’s first turn in the race, choose a racer predicted to win. If that racer becomes the winner, the race ends immediately and Mastermind receives second place.
implementation: On Mastermind’s first turn only, require a prediction target.
Watch first-place determination for the predicted racer.
If prediction is correct, immediately end the race and award Mastermind second place.
edgeCases: Mastermind may predict itself; the rules permit it to receive both first and second placement outcomes.

racers.name: Lackey
racers.uiSummary: When another racer’s finalized main-move die is 6, Lackey moves forward 2 before that racer performs its main movement.
implementation: Trigger only on another racer’s final accepted die face of 6.
Resolve Lackey +2 MOVE before the rolling racer moves.
edgeCases: Movement modifiers such as Gunk do not change the die face and therefore do not suppress this trigger.

racers.name: Loveable Loser
racers.uiSummary: Before its main move, if Loveable Loser is alone in last place, its owner gains 1 point.
implementation: Check alone + last immediately before main-move resolution.
Award +1 point once per qualifying turn.

racers.name: M.O.U.T.H.
racers.uiSummary: When M.O.U.T.H. stops on a space that already contains exactly one other eligible racer, eliminate that racer from the current race.
implementation: Evaluate the settled destination population with simultaneous-arrival metadata.
If exactly one other racer was already/legally present and the trigger is valid, eliminate it.
If only one active racer remains, end the race immediately and award the next applicable placement to that survivor.
edgeCases: Do not trigger solely because M.O.U.T.H. and the victim co-arrived simultaneously under the 2026 timing update.
If no racer can earn second place, leave those points unawarded.

racers.name: Leaptoad
racers.uiSummary: During any movement by Leaptoad, occupied track spaces do not count toward the number of spaces moved.
implementation: Construct movement path by counting only unoccupied positions toward distance.
Apply in both forward and backward movement.
Each occupied space skipped is a distinct occurrence of Leaptoad’s power for reaction purposes.
edgeCases: Scoocher can move once per occupied space Leaptoad skips.

racers.name: Magician
racers.uiSummary: Magician may reroll its main-move die up to two times using its own power, and must accept the last roll it chooses to keep or reaches.
implementation: After each eligible roll, prompt keep or POOF reroll while fewer than 2 POOF rerolls have been used.
The final accepted result becomes the finalized die face.
Each POOF reroll is a Magician power occurrence.
edgeCases: If Dicemonger is present, track its separate once-per-turn reroll independently from Magician’s two POOF rerolls.

racers.name: Party Animal
racers.uiSummary: Before Party Animal’s main move, every other active racer moves 1 space toward Party Animal. Then Party Animal gets +1 to its main-move amount for each other racer sharing its space.
implementation: Resolve the one-space pulls as one simultaneous movement group.
A racer already on Party Animal’s space has requested distance 0 toward it and does not perform a move.
After the group settles and occupancy corrections resolve, count other racers sharing Party Animal’s space and add that count to its main-move amount.
edgeCases: Under the latest erratum, simultaneous co-arrival from the pull does not itself trigger stop-together powers.
If Huge Baby is pulled onto the space, resolve Huge Baby occupancy and resulting displacement correctly.

racers.name: Rocket Scientist
racers.uiSummary: After seeing the finalized main-move die, Rocket Scientist may double that movement amount. If it does, Rocket Scientist becomes tripped for its next main move.
implementation: Prompt only after the accepted die face is known.
If chosen, double the relevant base/result movement amount at the correct modifier stage and mark Rocket Scientist tripped.
The current main move still completes; trip affects the next main move.

racers.name: Sisyphus
racers.uiSummary: Before the race begins, Sisyphus gains 4 points. Whenever its finalized main-move die is 6, it does not perform that main movement; instead it warps to Start and loses 1 point if it has a point available to lose.
implementation: Award +4 at BEFORE_RACE.
On own finalized main-move 6, cancel the main movement, warp to position 0, and subtract 1 from score only if score is above the applicable lower bound/no chip is available.
Do not perform a main movement after the warp.

racers.name: Romantic
racers.uiSummary: When a racer validly stops on a space that already has exactly one other racer, Romantic moves forward 2.
implementation: Evaluate after the arriving racer settles.
Suppress the trigger when the apparent pair was created solely by simultaneous co-arrival under the current erratum.
If valid, Romantic performs +2 MOVE.
edgeCases: The old Romantic + Suckerfish simultaneous-arrival combo is intentionally disabled by the 2026 update.

racers.name: Skipper
racers.uiSummary: Whenever any racer’s finalized main-move die is 1, Skipper becomes the next racer/player to act in turn order.
implementation: Trigger only on the final accepted die face 1.
Schedule Skipper as next after the current turn completes.
After Skipper’s turn, continue turn order from Skipper’s normal clockwise successor according to current multi-racer rules.
edgeCases: Skipper rolling 1 can result in Skipper being scheduled again.
With Inchworm, resolve Inchworm’s +1 reaction before the Skipper turn-order change takes effect.

racers.name: Scoocher
racers.uiSummary: Each time another racer’s power actually occurs, Scoocher moves forward 1.
implementation: Ignore Scoocher’s own power as a trigger source.
Generate +1 MOVE for every distinct qualifying power occurrence, not merely once per turn.
Preserve event lineage for loop detection.
edgeCases: Gunk can produce one Scoocher reaction per affected main-move debuff occurrence.
Leaptoad can produce one reaction per occupied space skipped.
Each Magician POOF reroll is a power occurrence.
A Dicemonger-granted reroll is a Dicemonger power occurrence.

racers.name: Stickler
racers.uiSummary: While Stickler is active, every other racer may cross Finish by movement only when that movement lands exactly on Finish. If the movement would overshoot, cancel that entire movement.
implementation: Apply to all MOVE causes: main, power, track arrow, duel movement, etc.
Do not apply the restriction to Stickler itself.
If another racer’s requested movement would end beyond position 30, prevent the entire move and leave the racer at its start position.
edgeCases: Warp is not a MOVE; target validation should separately prevent nonsensical beyond-finish warp destinations.

racers.name: Suckerfish
racers.uiSummary: When a racer sharing Suckerfish’s space begins a move, Suckerfish may follow that racer and arrive at the mover’s final space as part of the same movement group.
implementation: Prompt Suckerfish owner when an eligible co-located racer starts a MOVE.
If accepted, bind Suckerfish to the carrier for the full move; it cannot stop early.
Place Suckerfish at the carrier’s final destination with the same simultaneousGroupId.
Suckerfish can cross Finish this way.
edgeCases: Current erratum: the carrier and Suckerfish arrive simultaneously, so their pair does not create Romantic/M.O.U.T.H./similar stop-together triggers solely from that co-arrival.

racers.name: Third Wheel
racers.uiSummary: Before its main move, Third Wheel may warp to any track space currently containing exactly two racers, then still takes its normal main move.
implementation: Find all spaces with exactly two settled active racers.
Prompt no use or one valid destination.
Warp Third Wheel there, resolve legal stop state, then continue to its main move.

racers.name: Twin
racers.uiSummary: Before Twin’s race, it may choose a racer that won an earlier race; Twin uses that winner’s powers during this race.
implementation: Eligible sources are previous first-place racers from this game.
Twin keeps Twin identity/token but delegates power implementation to chosen winner.
Copied BEFORE_RACE powers also execute for Twin.
edgeCases: Race 1 has no previous winner, so no source is available.
